# Exact versions of every package CI installs from PyPI to build the sdist
# and the wheels, so a new release of any of them (broken or compromised)
# reaches a build only through a reviewed update of this file. Dependabot
# proposes updates after a seven-day cooldown (.github/dependabot.yml).
#
# Applied as PIP_CONSTRAINT and PIP_BUILD_CONSTRAINT (pip 26.2+ uses only the
# latter for isolated builds) by sdist.yml and the wheel jobs, as
# cibuildwheel's dependency-versions file (replacing its own pins), and
# inside the Linux containers as /constraints.txt.
#
# Regenerate with uv, cutting off releases newer than a week, then delete the
# cibuildwheel line (the action's pinned commit decides that version):
#   uv pip compile --universal --python-version 3.10 --exclude-newer <date> \
#     --no-header --no-annotate - <<'IN'
#   pip
#   build
#   virtualenv
#   delocate
#   delvewheel==1.13.1
#   abi3audit
#   cibuildwheel==<action version> ; python_version >= "3.11"
#   hatchling
#   scikit-build-core
#   cmake
#   ninja
#   IN
